spans.s:
शूयमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Swelling, enlarging, expanding.
 E. श्वि to swell, शानच् aff.

सुयन्त्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Well-governed or regulated.
 E. सु, यन्त्रित restrained.
सुयवस n. (-सं) Beautiful grass, good pasturage.

सुयामुन m. (-नः)
 1. A name of VIṢṆ

. A prince, sovereign of
Kośāmbi; also named VATSA-

. A palace.
 4. A mountain. E.
सु well, यमुना the river, and अण् aff.

सुयुद्ध n. (-द्धं) A well fought war or battle.
 E. सु, and युद्ध war.

सुयोधन m. (-नः) A name of DURYODHANA, the chief of the Kuru family.
E. सु well, or with pleasure, युध् to combat, युच् aff.

सूयान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Dexterous, clever.
 n. (-नं) Good effort or exertion.
E. सु well, उत्थान exertion.
